## Incidencias por organización
Filtra primero por rango de tiempo; luego, opcionalmente, por **ManagingOrganizationId** y **OrganizationId**. `All` = sin filtro.

parameters.name: ManagingOrganizationId
parameters.label: ManagingOrganizationId
parameters.description: All = todas. '(sin Managing Org)' = solo registros que no traen ese ID.
parameters.query:
union exceptions, requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where not(itemType == "exception" and client_Type == "Browser")
| where tostring(customDimensions) contains "organizationid"
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd),
         OrgId   = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)
| where isnotempty(MgOrgId)
| summarize n = sum(itemCount) by MgOrgId
| order by n desc
| project value = MgOrgId, label = MgOrgId
| union (print value = "__none__", label = "(sin Managing Org)")

parameters.name: OrganizationId
parameters.label: OrganizationId
parameters.description: Lista las organizaciones de la Managing Org elegida (o todas si está en All).
parameters.query:
let MgOrg = "{ManagingOrganizationId}";
let AllVals = dynamic(["", "*", "value::all"]);
union exceptions, requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where not(itemType == "exception" and client_Type == "Browser")
| where tostring(customDimensions) contains "organizationid"
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd),
         OrgId   = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)
| where MgOrg in (AllVals) or (MgOrg == "__none__" and isempty(MgOrgId)) or MgOrgId == MgOrg
| where isnotempty(OrgId)
| summarize n = sum(itemCount), Mg = take_anyif(MgOrgId, isnotempty(MgOrgId)) by OrgId
| order by n desc
| project value = OrgId, label = strcat(OrgId, "  ·  ", iff(isempty(Mg), "sin Managing Org", strcat("MgOrg ", Mg)))

content.query:
let MgOrg = "{ManagingOrganizationId}";
let Org = "{OrganizationId}";
let AllVals = dynamic(["", "*", "value::all"]);
let F = exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd),
         OrgId   = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)
| where MgOrg in (AllVals) or (MgOrg == "__none__" and isempty(MgOrgId)) or MgOrgId == MgOrg
| where Org in (AllVals) or OrgId == Org;
F
| summarize Excepciones = sum(itemCount),
            MgOrgs = dcountif(MgOrgId, isnotempty(MgOrgId)),
            Orgs = dcountif(OrgId, isnotempty(OrgId)),
            SinId = sumif(itemCount, isempty(MgOrgId) and isempty(OrgId))
| project Data = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metrica", "Excepciones", "Valor", Excepciones),
    bag_pack("Metrica", "Managing orgs afectadas", "Valor", MgOrgs),
    bag_pack("Metrica", "Organizaciones afectadas", "Valor", Orgs),
    bag_pack("Metrica", "Sin ID asociado", "Valor", SinId))
| mv-expand Data
| project Metrica = tostring(Data.Metrica), Valor = tolong(Data.Valor)
content.title: Resumen

content.query:
let MgOrg = "{ManagingOrganizationId}";
let Org = "{OrganizationId}";
let AllVals = dynamic(["", "*", "value::all"]);
let F = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd),
         OrgId   = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)
| where MgOrg in (AllVals) or (MgOrg == "__none__" and isempty(MgOrgId)) or MgOrgId == MgOrg
| where Org in (AllVals) or OrgId == Org;
F
| summarize Requests = sum(itemCount),
            Fallidas = sumif(itemCount, success == false),
            P95 = percentile(duration, 95)
| extend PctFallo = round(100.0 * Fallidas / Requests, 1)
| project Data = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metrica", "Requests", "Valor", Requests),
    bag_pack("Metrica", "Requests fallidas", "Valor", Fallidas),
    bag_pack("Metrica", "% de fallo", "Valor", PctFallo),
    bag_pack("Metrica", "Duración P95 (ms)", "Valor", round(P95, 0)))
| mv-expand Data
| project Metrica = tostring(Data.Metrica), Valor = todouble(Data.Valor)
content.title: Resumen
Requests fallidas en el tiempo

content.query:
let MgOrg = "{ManagingOrganizationId}";
let Org = "{OrganizationId}";
let AllVals = dynamic(["", "*", "value::all"]);
let F = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd),
         OrgId   = extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)
| where MgOrg in (AllVals) or (MgOrg == "__none__" and isempty(MgOrgId)) or MgOrgId == MgOrg
| where Org in (AllVals) or OrgId == Org;
F
| extend RawId = iff(MgOrg in (AllVals), MgOrgId, OrgId)
| extend Nivel = iff(MgOrg in (AllVals), "Managing Org", "Organization")
| summarize Requests = sum(itemCount),
            Fallidas = sumif(itemCount, success == false),
            P95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0)
          by Nivel, Id = iff(isempty(RawId), "(sin ID)", RawId)
| extend PctFallo = round(100.0 * Fallidas / Requests, 1)
| order by Fallidas desc, Requests desc
content.title: Desglose (Managing Org → Organization)
